title: Mapping relative landscape suitability for Apis cerana beekeeping in Kavrepalanchowk, Nepal: code (WLC, WPM, TOPSIS) v2.0.0
description: Python package and scripts for a GIS multi-criteria landscape-suitability model for Apis cerana beekeeping with literature-pooled weights, 1991-2020 climate normals, three aggregation models (WLC, weighted product, TOPSIS), an independent recomputation, an 81-scenario sensitivity ensemble, unit tests and a verification script.
